name: applicationId
note: engine-id (8 bits) + selector (24 bits); CLI collect application name; exportable under v9 and IPFIX; engine ids per RFC 6759 section 4.1: 3 IANA-L4 (port based), 6 USER-Defined (custom), 13 PANA-L7 (NBAR2 layer 7)

name: applicationName
note: carried by option application-table, not in data records

name: HTTP Host
note: Cisco 2015 guide: 45003, IPFIX only, max 512 chars IOS / 2 KB IOS XE; libfds defines appHTTPHost as 12235; see NOTES.md

name: HTTP URI statistics
note: type octetArray is an nl6 encoder decision, not a sourced fact: Cisco names no IPFIX type and libfds (the only stated type) says string, but the field embeds NUL bytes and binary counts, so IPFIX string semantics would be wrong; URI/count pairs repeat back to back: NUL(0x00)-delimited URI string then a 2-byte integer hit count, byte order not stated; IOS truncates URI at 512 chars, IOS XE caps the field at 2 KB; max hit count 65535; see NOTES.md; hit-count byte order is NOT stated by Cisco and is an encoder assumption unit 2 must decide before this field is emitted

name: applicationDescription
note: non-scope field of the application-table options template (RFC 6759 section 4.3); Cisco 2015 guide: offset 28, length 55 in option application-table; RFC 6759 section 7.1.1 registers it as Abstract Data Type string with no fixed length
